name: Andy Bogard
source: Terry's younger brother, though a lot more quiet and modest than him. Andy is much more withdrawn and analytical than his older brother. He has a bit of an inferiority complex and would like to one day best his brother. Andy also has a moe side! He's very self conscious about his height, and is somewhat allergic to romantic commitment. Any of these things will send him into hysterics and embarrass him.
